definitions.gloss: decorative paper or ornament for gifts
definitions.explanation: A traditional Japanese decorative element attached to formal gifts, originally strips of dried abalone but now typically a printed design on gift wrapping paper.

examples.japanese: ⟦お{祝|いわ}い→お祝い：01339_oiwai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{品|しな}→品：03192_shina⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{熨斗|のし}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{付|つ}けて→付ける：00761_tsukeru⟧⟦もらった→もらう：00520_morau⟧。
examples.english: I had noshi attached to the celebratory gift.

examples.japanese: {熨斗|のし}{紙|がみ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{名前|なまえ}→名前：02234_namae⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{書|か}いて→書く：00477_kaku⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please write your name on the noshi paper.

examples.japanese: ⟦{結婚祝|けっこんいわ}い→結婚祝い：19656_kekkoniwai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{紅白|こうはく}→紅白：13805_kouhaku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{熨斗|のし}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{使|つか}う→使う：00473_tsukau⟧。
examples.english: For wedding gifts, red and white noshi is used.

notes:
CULTURAL CONTEXT: {熨斗|のし} is an essential element of formal Japanese gift-giving etiquette.

ORIGIN: Originally {熨斗鮑|のしあわび} - strips of dried abalone stretched thin, symbolizing longevity. Now represented by a stylized design.

COMPONENTS OF {熨斗|のし}{紙|がみ}:
- ⟦{水引|みずひき}→水引：29258_mizuhiki⟧: decorative cord/ribbon
- {熨斗|のし}: the ornament (upper right)
- {表書|おもてが}き: purpose of the gift
- ⟦{名前|なまえ}→名前：02234_namae⟧: giver's name (below center)

USAGE BY OCCASION:
- ⟦{祝儀|しゅうぎ}→祝儀：06225_shuugi⟧ (celebrations): uses {熨斗|のし}
- ⟦{不祝儀|ぶしゅうぎ}→不祝儀：06445_bushuugi⟧ (condolences): NO {熨斗|のし}

WHEN NOT TO USE:
- Funerals and memorial services
- Gifts of fresh food or fish (already from the sea)
- Some casual gift occasions

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {熨斗|のし}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{付|つ}ける→付ける：00761_tsukeru⟧: to add noshi
- {熨斗|のし}{紙|がみ}: noshi wrapping paper
- {内熨斗|うちのし}: noshi inside wrapping
- {外熨斗|そとのし}: noshi outside wrapping
